detail.longDescription: I have searched to find a solution for (Astro)N(eo)vim, and it is commonly suggested to set a tab equivalent to a default number of blank characters. However, I have observed that even if I set these variables in a configuration file, vim.opt.tabstop = 2 vim.opt.softtabstop = 2 vim.opt.shiftwidth = 2 Unfortunately, for Python files a separate additional line is needed: vim.cmd [[autocmd FileType python set shiftwidth=2 tabstop=2 expandtab]] If this line is not provided, e.g the tabstop option is not applied but only in Python files . This is also possibly related to this question: NeoVim tab size (shiftwidth, tabstop) constantly changing in Insert mode in Lua files In this answer , the usage of the g:python_indent variable is advised, but I receive errors when trying to set it inside the configuration file. Is there a more generic/elegant solution apart from using the extra line mentioned above?
